# Historical compiled source workflow fixtures

These unchanged compiled files are copied from source commit `7a15964` for the
organization migration validator's synthetic historical installation captures.
They are outside `.github/workflows` and are not executed or deployed from here.
Do not compile, install or enable them during the central App pilot.

The final eight source validation, release and credential workflow samples were retired on 2026-10-09. Offline tests read these preserved bytes here; they are not active GitHub Actions workflows.
